reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse CA system, water depth now updates efficiently, allowing for smoother gameplay when shaping the land. You can raise a lip, dig a ditch, or turn on a well without freezing the frame! Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
